item.tib: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las bsad pa jo dmar dgu sgril ge shan srog gi spu gri
item.coloph: ces pa 'di snying grogs dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs kyis snga nas bskur (bskul) ba dang / phyis su bla chung bstan dbang dang / yang slob btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs nas dri med gsang gos yug ring gis mtshon te bskur (bskul) ba la brten nas/ dri med gang ka'i rigs grol rgod rje rgya yi gdung las grol ba'i sdom brtson tha shar (shal) ba/ 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po bdag gis snyigs ma'i 'gro la phan pa'i phyir du rig 'dzin dpa' bo'i gsang lung dngos su thob pa bzhin/ rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor mngon zhal mjal ba'i nyin par brgyud cing spel ba'o/ dge des bstan dgra ming med du brlag pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
